description:
After the required skill-integrity lane lands, validate it on the first three legitimate skill-only consumer PRs. Use the existing `dev_loop_pr_metrics.py` `event_fanout_v1` model and the path-decision/check artifacts. Confirm product jobs do not start, the skill job and required umbrella succeed, strict-current-base refreshes remain correctly bound, and no false skip or full-certification mislabel occurs. Report required-gate/merge-unblock wall time, all-workflow wall time, successful runner-minutes, cancelled runner-minutes, queue delay, and post-merge ci-lint cost separately. Derive a durable budget only from three distinct samples; do not label savings measured before then and do not weaken gates in this observational item.

The observation window begins with the first legitimate skill-only PR after the implementation merges. The report must contain a structured table with exactly identified `sample-1`, `sample-2`, and `sample-3` rows, each carrying a PR number plus distinct 40-character head and base SHAs. If fewer than three legitimate PRs exist after 14 calendar days, publish an interim report marked `INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE`, record the observed rows and next review date, and block this TODO with the missing sample count. Do not derive a durable budget or complete the item. Continue collection until three samples exist, unless a later explicit user decision changes the evidence requirement. If no samples exist, block it as awaiting a legitimate canary rather than creating a synthetic trigger.

Use `behind-pr-occurrence-02-throughput-measurement` / PR #1756 as the immutable pre-lane baseline; do not reopen or rewrite it. Its 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-17 sample reports overall develop-merge interarrival p50 31.3 minutes and 50% of gaps below 31 minutes, before a skill lane existed. The tracker CLI currently cannot add an item dependency through `todo update`; this citation is the binding baseline and does not delay C after A.

The post-A report must stratify rather than average: full-product, skill-only, and mixed required-gate durations; overall interarrival and interarrival by merged lane; open-stale versus in-flight staleness; skill-only merges landing during an in-flight full-product gate; full-product PRs becoming BEHIND after a skill-only merge versus after another full-product merge; and, for every sampled skill merge, the lanes of other open PRs during its gate, time until their refresh, and cancelled runner-minutes attributable to that refresh. It must state whether skill merge-unblock improved while aggregate refresh churn rose.

Record refresh-shadow reason codes by lane. `prior_certification_not_full` for a skill-only parent is expected ineligibility by design, not a classifier miss; do not reinterpret 02's pre-lane 0/10 `shadow_eligible` result as post-lane failure. This item stays observational: it may provide evidence to a later activation alongside 02, but must not recommend, unblock, implement, or rewrite 07a reduced-refresh modes or 07b `merge_group` support.

2026-09-07 reconciliation: #2077 evidence corrections are merged; only one legitimate sample is proven. Done units w0-w4 record an interim checkpoint, not three-sample acceptance. Pending w5-w6 now own the missing samples and final assessment. Replace manual job sums with the corrected existing collector from ci-baseline-representative-remeasure-sample. This specialized lane cannot establish completion of pr-process-low-drama-acceptance or authorize changes to required product/queue lanes.

anti_patterns.dont: create a second metrics implementation or manually sum selected jobs
anti_patterns.why: parallel metric definitions drift and mishandle reruns or cancellations

anti_patterns.dont: exclude cancelled synchronize attempts from the report
anti_patterns.instead: show cancelled consumption in its own bucket
anti_patterns.why: concurrency cancellation can make completed-run savings look better than total churn

anti_patterns.dont: measure only the pr.yml skill job or omit independent workflows
anti_patterns.instead: report required-gate, all-workflow, queue, successful, cancelled, and post-merge dimensions
anti_patterns.why: a narrow workflow-only number understates user-visible and system-wide cost

anti_patterns.dont: treat five minutes or ten runner-minutes as a pre-proven hard contract
anti_patterns.instead: derive the budget from the first three samples and use five minutes as an investigation threshold
anti_patterns.why: always-on workflow floors and clean-runner setup cost were not measured before rollout

anti_patterns.dont: weaken, bypass, or reroute a gate while performing validation
anti_patterns.instead: record the defect and create a separately reviewed implementation follow-up
anti_patterns.why: measurement does not authorize remediation or safety-policy changes
